purpose: LLM-facing contract for deciding how to trigger the CRYENGINE asset pipeline and tracker from natural-language requests.

routing_notes: Use create when the user is asking for a new asset from natural language.
Use edit when the user wants to revise an existing staged job or change a generated spec.
Use build when a job already has request/spec data and needs staged artifacts.
Use validate before publish unless the run command already performed validation.
Use convert_mesh for local geometry import requests such as OBJ, FBX, DAE, DXF, or 3DS.
Use tracker status/next/resume for conversation continuity and job discovery.

create.intent: Create a new asset job and generate its structured spec.

edit.intent: Modify an existing job request or structured spec before rebuilding.
behavior: If prompt is provided for a level job, regenerate the level spec from the updated prompt.
Apply dotted-path overrides after prompt regeneration.
Mark the tracker status as edited.

build.intent: Generate staged CRYENGINE-compatible artifacts for a job.

publish.intent: Copy validated staged assets into the project Assets tree.
safety_rules: Do not publish if validation_report.json is missing.
Do not publish if validation_report.json reports failed status.

convert_mesh.intent: Stage a local geometry asset for CRYENGINE import and optional compilation.
constraints: Use FBX or DAE for skeletal character or animated vehicle import.
If CRYENGINE compiler tooling is unavailable, keep the job staged instead of failing silently.

status.intent: Show tracker state and job inventory.

resume.intent: Resume the pipeline in a future conversation with the current state summary.

when_to_trigger: The user describes a new level, terrain, arena, or environment in natural language.
The user wants a CRYENGINE-compatible package published into Assets/levels/.
The user wants to revise an existing generated level package.
The user names a job id or asks to tweak biome, size, lighting, terrain, or prompt.
The user provides or references a local OBJ/FBX/DAE/DXF/3DS asset to bring into the project.
The user asks to convert bought/downloaded geometry into a CRYENGINE-compatible mesh package.
The user asks what the pipeline is doing now.
The user wants to continue a previous asset job.

before_execution: Choose the verb or skill that best matches the request.
Infer sensible defaults when the user did not provide explicit values.
Prefer run/create_level_package for a new level request unless the user explicitly wants a staged-only result.
after_execution: Report the selected verb or skill.
Report the concrete command that was run.
Report the job_id when a job was created or reused.
Report key output files or published asset paths.
If validation failed, summarize the blocking errors and stop before publish.
